name: ManguSta -Chijoku Fuuki Iinkai-
source:
Private Haritani Academy—
"Extraterritoriality" and "Male Supremacy" run rampant in this closed-off space.

Under the banner of "student self-governance," students belonging to various committees—led by the student council—hold sway over the general student body. Among the general students, girls are referred to as "lower-tier students" and are expected to "obey absolutely" the commands of those in higher positions.
In this school, a place following outdated, harmful traditions, a strange disappearance has occurred.

You take on the role of the protagonist, Isugi, the head of the disciplinary committee. Your task is to gather information by questioning various students, using informants, and conducting your own investigations to uncover the truth behind the mystery.
The Disciplinary Committee holds the authority to impose punishments on students—a power known as the "Student Guidance and Disciplinary Authority."
The more you used every illegal means at you disposal to get closer to the truth of the incident,
the more you found yourself unavoidably drawn to the student council—led by the quiet yet formidable student council president, Sakuragi Hayato.
It wouldn't take long for you to realize that the darker force hiding beneath the surface—what some called the "System"—had, in fact, spread its influence over the entire school.

translation:
私立张谷学院——在这个封闭的空间里，“治外法权”和“男尊女卑”横行无忌。在“学生自治”的旗帜下，以学生会为首的各委员会成员对学生行使着统治权。在普通学生中，女生被称为“下级生”，被要求“绝对服从”上级的命令。在这所遵循着落后有害传统的学校里，发生了一起神秘失踪事件。你扮演主人公——风纪委员长杉，你的任务是通过审问学生、利用线人、自行调查来揭开谜团背后的真相。风纪委员会拥有对学生实施惩罚的权力——被称为“学生指导与惩戒权”。你越是利用一切非法手段接近事件的真相，就越是不可避免地被学生会所吸引——由沉默而强大的学生会长樱木隼人领导。你很快就会意识到，隐藏在表象之下的更黑暗的力量——有人称之为“系统”——实际上已经将影响力扩散到了整个学校。
